profile.description: nLIGHT designs, manufactures, and sells high-power semiconductor and fiber lasers for directed energy weapons, optical sensing, and advanced manufacturing applications. The company is vertically integrated from semiconductor chip to fiber amplifier to beam-combined laser weapon systems, including the HADES directed energy platform. nLIGHT won a $627M Joint Laser Weapon System (JLWS) contract in July 2026 and delivered record Q2 2026 revenue of $82.6M (+33.8% YoY). Manufacturing facilities in Vancouver/Camas, WA and Longmont, CO (doubled capacity in January 2026). Market cap ~$2.3B.
